purpose: Teach: 見知らぬ/さんざん/もどる/気まま/だんだんと/何気なく/アナタ/ありとあらゆる

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、見知らぬ人に話しかけるなよ
lines.style: Sharp, protective warning. Quick tempo. Delivered like she's said this before and means it. No room for negotiation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、昨日のテスト、さんざんだったろ?桜
lines.en: You totally bombed that test yesterday, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle tease, checking in under the provocation. Warm but careful. Pace slows slightly on the question, like he's genuinely curious about the answer.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、もどる前に荷物まとめろよ, 本気で
lines.en: Riku, pack your stuff before we head back. I'm serious.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, no-nonsense. Said while already moving. Light exasperation — he's being slower than she'd like. Direct eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、休日は気ままに過ごすんだろ?桜
lines.en: You get to spend your days off however you want though, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Thoughtful observation dressed as a question. Slower pace. He's asking something that matters to him, not just making conversation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、だんだんと部活が楽しくなってきたな
lines.en: You know, club's actually been getting more fun lately.
lines.style: Quiet realization, almost surprised at herself for saying it. Soft opening. Pace slows on the admission. Slight wonder in the trailing tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、何気なくぼくに「ありがとう」って言ったろ?桜
lines.en: The other day you just... thanked me casually, like it was nothing. Did you mean it?
lines.style: Vulnerable underneath the careful wording. Hesitant rhythm — he's asking something that matters. Soft peak on the question, trailing into genuine uncertainty.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、アナタが応援してくれて嬉しいよ
lines.en: I'm really glad you're cheering me on.
lines.style: Direct and sincere. Opens softly. Steady pace, no rush to finish. The kind of honesty that takes effort to say out loud.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ありとあらゆるスポーツやってんな、桜
lines.en: You're out here doing every sport under the sun, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Admiring, slightly in awe. Warm and close. Pace is easy — he's not challenging, just noticing and being impressed by what she does.
